w: Swamishri was shown a couple of sentences in English, that he would have to speak in a quiz arranged for children from USA. The first sentence was, "I will take you to Akshardham." On finding out what it meant, Swamishri corrected it, "The sentence should be ‘Shriji Maharaj will take you to Akshardham.’ If we say ‘I’ then we will become arrogant and egotistic. It should be Shriji Maharaj." There is no arrogance or egotism in Swamishri but his devotion and conviction of Shriji Maharaj’s doership is immensely inspiring.

The evening program at the ' Swaminarayan Nagar' included a drama performance by the kishores and youths depicting the transformation of Joban Pagi, the faith of Khimo Sutar, the steadiness of Abhaysinh Darbar and honesty of Govind Bhagat. After every performance parallel incidents from the life of Pramukh Swami Maharaj were narrated by the sadhus.

Cure for Mental Illness "Jai Swaminarayan doctor!" Swamishri addressed a youth called Jayesh. "He is not a doctor. He is studying psychiatry," someone added. "Even a psychiatrist is a doctor. Some are doctors of the physical body, some of the mind," Swamishri replied. And then looking at Jayesh, Swamishri asked. "Isn't that true?" "Yes Swami," replied Jayesh. "Do you know how to cure the diseases and afflictions of the mind?" Swamishri asked Jayesh. Jayesh remained quiet, not knowing what to say. At this pause Swamishri confidently replied, "Say Swaminarayan, Swaminarayan and the diseases of mind will be cured." Swamishri casually revealed the chanting of God's holy name as the panacea of all mental ills.
After Swamishri's morning puja, the kalash vidhi for the Houston Mandir was held, during which Swamishri performed the pujan of the kalashes.

In the morning Guru Purnima assembly, the senior sadhus spoke of Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s exemplary saintliness and unique glory as an ideal guru. Then, serveral new Swaminarayan Aksharpith publications were inaugurated: Pramukh Vandana – audio cassette with bhajans hailing the glory of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, Swabhav-vash Sansar, a Gujarati publication written by Viveksagar Swami and Rishis, Mystics and Heroes of India, an English publication in colour written by Mukundcharan Swami. Afterwards, Swamishri was honoured with garlands and then, finally, Swamishri blessed the 70,000 devotees who has gathered for the Guru Purnima festival, “Ved Vyas has written the glory of God in many scriptures. That form of God is explained as it is by the Gunatit Sadhu. And Maharaj has written in the Vachanamrut that He has brought such a sadhu (with Him) from Akshardham, as well as countless muktas and His powers. Bhagwan Swaminarayan came on this earth so that countless jivas could reach the divine Akshardham of God and attain moksha.”
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of Nilkanth Varni ( abhishek murti ) for the mandirs in Nairobi and Kisumu in Kenya.
